interpretation.near_boundary_actual_error: Near-boundary values use truth within 0.25 tolerance half-width of either boundary and report absolute prediction-minus-truth error.
interpretation.serving_scope: Exactly two resistor leaves in each front and tail canonical S/P branch.
interpretation.test_partition: The test partition contains retained parent rows and the fresh supplemental test setup context; source-separated metrics are reported for selected models.
interpretation.unsupported_routes: research_3uf LI/OSHUNT_v0 and SI/OSHUNT_v0 have no feasible validation requests; retention/regret are unavailable and regression fallback is used.
